notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
description:
Activate Yuna by tapping it, adding {1} and causing the next creature spell you cast to enter with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Yuna.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast a creature spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with infinite +1/+1 counters due to Yuna.
